metadata.name: @asanali/linux-js
metadata.description: A lightweight Linux kernel emulation framework written in modular JavaScript.
metadata.author: Asanali

overview.summary: Linux.js is a modular framework simulating the Linux kernel architecture (torvalds/linux style) inside pure JavaScript environments (Node.js and browsers).

module.name: kernel.js
module.description: Core kernel orchestrator and command dispatcher.

module.name: fs.js
module.description: Virtual File System (VFS) supporting directories, files, and tree navigation.

module.name: mm.js
module.description: Memory Management subsystem tracking allocation and RAM usage.

module.name: net.js
module.description: Network stack simulation with loopback and interface management.
